reason: I'd maybe call the demo line out of curiosity, but I'm not handing my customers to a robot and paying two grand up front before I've seen it not screw up a real call. I can't even find time to answer my Google reviews, so I'm not starting a whole setup project this week either.
objection: A machine gives one of my customers a wrong answer or messes up an appointment, they go to the next guy, and I don't even know it happened. On top of that, $2,000 is gone before I know if it works.
would_change_my_mind: Hearing it handle a real emergency call properly in Québec French, plus a first month where I can walk away and get the setup fee back if it costs me a customer.
